title: Intent Journal
tagline: AI journal embeds intents, recs 1inch Fusion+ swaps on Etherlink, gens social posts
description:
IntentJournal+ - AI-Powered DeFi Intent Management Platform
What Problem Does This Solve?
The DeFi Complexity Crisis: Current DeFi platforms overwhelm users with technical jargon, complex protocols, and fragmented experiences. Users struggle to translate their financial intentions ("I want to save for green tech" or "I need to hedge against market volatility") into actionable DeFi strategies.

IntentJournal+ bridges this gap by creating the first AI-powered intent management system that transforms natural language financial thoughts into optimized DeFi actions across the entire 1inch ecosystem.

Core Concept: Intent-Based DeFi
The Golden Path Experience:

Journal Your Intent: Write financial thoughts in natural language ("I want to diversify into stablecoins")
AI Analysis: Venice AI creates semantic embeddings and analyzes your intent patterns
Smart Recommendations: AI suggests optimal 1inch protocol strategies based on your goals
One-Click Execution: Execute trades through the best 1inch protocol for your specific intent
Social Sharing: Generate posts with transaction visualizations and performance analytics
Example User Journey:

User writes: "Market feels volatile, want to move 50% of my ETH to USDC for stability"
AI analyzes intent: Risk reduction + stablecoin preference + partial position sizing
Recommendation: Use 1inch Fusion+ for cross-chain USDC with MEV protection
Execution: One-click swap with optimal routing and gasless execution
Social: Auto-generate post showing portfolio rebalancing with performance charts
how_its_made:
How IntentJournal+ is Built - Technical Deep Dive
Core Technology Stack
Frontend Architecture
Next.js 15 with App Router for modern React patterns
TypeScript throughout for type safety and developer experience
Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui for consistent, responsive design system
Zustand for lightweight state management
React Query for server state and caching

Web3 Integration
wagmi v2 + viem for type-safe Ethereum interactions
RainbowKit for wallet connection UI
Para Wallet SDK for OAuth-based wallet integration
WalletConnect v2 for multi-wallet support

AI & Embeddings
Venice AI API for semantic embeddings and chat completions
Custom embedding store with localStorage persistence
Vector similarity search for intent pattern matching
